patches.name: Keep Helium Child Processes Alive
patches.description: Experimental version-unpinned structural/data-flow patch: starts one main-process foreground service with persistent low-priority notification and forces child STRONG binding plus IMPORTANT/STRONG priority updates. Tolerates routine signature, register, and helper-name changes; ambiguous targets fail closed. May increase RAM, battery, and process pressure; mitigates LMK kills only.

patches.name: Block Quetta bundled extension installation
patches.description: Blocks bundled extension installation/reinstallation on arm64-v8a APKs (the framework does not enforce ABI restrictions). Does not remove copies already present in existing profiles. Takes effect immediately on clean installs.
